title: Require manager approval for corrected timesheets
objective: Prevent unreviewed changes to previously approved time records
statement: When an approved timesheet is corrected, it must return to manager approval before becoming final.
assumptions: Existing approval history must remain visible
open_questions: Should invoice export be blocked while re-approval is pending?
acceptance_criteria: Given an approved timesheet, when a permitted user changes a billable entry, then the timesheet status becomes pending approval.
The prior approval remains available in history with approver and timestamp.
